note: Re-judged 2026-10-19 (independent auditor, after 691bd048e9). draft-ietf-bess-mup-safi Section 3.3.6: "When a BGP speaker receives a MP_REACH_NLRI attribute update message with a Direct Segment Discovery route without a prefix SID attribute, than it MUST be treated as if it contained a malformed prefix SID attribute and the "Treat-as-withdraw procedure of [RFC7606] is applied.  A BGP speaker MUST skip such NLRIs and continue processing of rest of the Update message." The earlier unimplemented verdict is superseded: mup/rfc7606.go::CheckDSDPrefixSID is registered by mup/register.go for both ipv4/mup and ipv6/mup through nlritype.RegisterUpdateCheck, and the receive path (Session.applyRFC7606 -> applyTypedNLRIDiscard -> typedNLRIEdit -> nlritype.RetainUpdate) moves an announced DSD route with no Prefix-SID out of MP_REACH_NLRI into MP_UNREACH_NLRI per NLRI, keeping its siblings and the session; typedNLRIUpdateAttrs counts a Prefix-SID that RFC 7606 attribute-discard removes (the RFC 8669 Section 4 EBGP rule) as absent. Tests drive whole hex UPDATE bodies through Session.enforceRFC7606 and assert exact bytes: TestMUPDSDWithoutPrefixSIDWithdrawnOnReceive (kept MP_REACH NLRI equals the ISD sibling, MP_UNREACH NLRI equals the DSD route, no error, for both an absent and an EBGP-discarded Prefix-SID) and TestMUPDSDWithPrefixSIDKeptOnReceive (DSD with a Prefix-SID, and ISD plus Type 2 ST without one, return RFC7606ActionNone and the UPDATE byte for byte). The recorded discrimination breaks are panics, which prove reach only, so five overlay mutants were run (go test -overlay, tags ze_core ze_bgp): Keep instead of Withdraw when the Prefix-SID is absent (positive red, both cases); withdraw a DSD even with a Prefix-SID (negative DSD case red); drop the route-type test so every type is withdrawn (positive and negative ISD/T2ST case red); Discard instead of Withdraw (positive red, "withdrawn, not dropped"); ignore attribute-discard entries in typedNLRIUpdateAttrs (positive EBGP-discard case red). All five killed. Residual: only AFI 1 is exercised; the AFI 2 family is covered by the same registration loop, not by a test. test/plugin/mup-dsd-without-prefix-sid-withdraw.ci exists but is untagged and was not run here.
